coreReview.verdict: No actionable findings. Five core/generator files and runtime test are exact frozen private copies; only Make default/define forwarding is new relative to the public base. The existing B16/385024 RTX preset is preserved.

plumbingReview: ECC_PACKED_WEIGHTED_PREFIX is a string enum0/1/2 with default0. Nonzero values require polynomial state/chains, denominator cache and paired products; mode2 additionally requires the walk-network bit. Existing parent guards run before the new guard.
Image environment and image Make command carry the selected mode. BAKED/buildFor/runBench reuse identities include the exact integer schedule, so switching modes cannot reuse the old baked binary.
Rebuild commands, benchmarkIdentity, benchmark/autotune/compile-check result metadata carry the selected schedule. Default bitsliced metadata uses None.
checkPackedReduction requires exactly one matching runtime weighted-prefix marker. Missing, duplicate, invalid or mismatched markers keep the sample invalid and force its rankable rate to zero.

packed_audit forwards the mode into the arithmetic Make target, checks exactly one matching arithmetic marker, and requires exactly one6240-pair PASS line before integration or any timing. Failures stop the audit path before benchmarking.
Benchmark and collection samples pass the same marker/count validator; expected and actual schedule values are retained as integers. Batch/worker/full scalar count gates remain intact.

The copied test calls the pair helper directly in mode2 and scalar sigma twice in modes0/1; both outputs, all basis directions and dense/edge pairs are checked. Sentinel and padding checks and all five existing suites are preserved.
Documentation keeps the mode default0 and describes host/compiler evidence without promoting a measured GPU gain.
